title: Word cards made by the teacher: 10 real and 10 alien words (list in the notes)
subject: English
source: Seeded from english/y1 lessons 80, 81 (Word cards made by the teacher: 10 real and 10 alien words (list in the notes))
intro: To understand how to read real and alien words calmly using our phonics, as in the screening check

cards:
alien word
a pretend word that we read
using our sounds; it has no meaning

blend
push the sounds together to
read a word

check
a short test that shows what
we can do

split digraph
two letters that work together
with a letter in between: a-e

syllable
a beat in a word
blocks.task: use them to test yourself or a partner.

questions.model: I do: s-t-a-m-p, blend: stamp. b-e-n-ch, blend: bench. Each sound once, then the word.

questions.q: Read the alien words: thab, quist

questions.model: I do: i-e split by b: t-r-/igh/-b, tribe. oa says /oa/: g-r-oa-n, groan.

questions.q: Read the alien words: slome, prait
read the 10 real words on the practice card to your partner
questions.a: chip, sheep, ring, stamp, frog, bench, torch, coin, shed, thin
questions.model: I do first: point under chip, say ch-i-p, blend chip. Then the next word.

questions.q: read the 10 alien words on the card
questions.a: vop, zort, thab, gloop, frim, quist, blint, sarb, jeck, moik

questions.q: write two alien words of your own and read them
read the 10 real words on the section 2 practice card
questions.a: tribe, groan, sunset, rocket, slide, coat, night, drain, picnic, stroke
questions.model: I do first: tribe: spot i-e, say t-r-/igh/-b, blend tribe.

questions.q: write a two-syllable alien word and read it
